description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the Gdpr model within the Opencart catalog module. It provides methods to manage GDPR-related data such as adding GDPR requests, editing status, retrieving GDPR records by ID or code, and fetching GDPR records by email or expiration criteria.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Represents the GDPR data handling model in the Account namespace, providing CRUD operations and retrieval methods for GDPR records.

methods.name: addGdpr
methods.description: Inserts a new GDPR record into the database with the given code, email, and action.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the 'status' field of a GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its GDPr ID.

methods.name: getGdprByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its unique code.

methods.name: getGdprsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches all GDPR records associated with a specific email address.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Returns GDPR records with a 'status' of 2 and a 'date_added' earlier than the configured limit.
